verdict.rationale: Atlas docs cover incorporation, the EIN, 83(b) filings, equity, banking and SAFEs, but none of them mention filing annual reports or franchise tax. One community comment says Atlas made 'filing 2017 taxes trivial', but it does not say these were franchise tax or annual report filings. Other community reports say founders must handle state-level legwork and Delaware franchise tax exposure themselves, with no warnings from Atlas.
